special_note: 16 October starts after the user’s NPTEL exam scheduled 09:00–12:00. Routine timing is adjustable; breaks and sleep are intentional. This schedule is a recommended plan, not an official RIL timetable.

days.label: Day 0 — Setup sprint (after NPTEL exam)
days.focus: Set up the system, do not over-study after your morning NPTEL exam

blocks.task: Recover, eat and reset after the NPTEL exam.
Open the study dashboard; record baseline confidence in Quant, Reasoning and Instrumentation.
Take 10 untimed diagnostic questions from each track to find obvious gaps.
Set up your formula notebook and mistake log; review the assessment facts.
Light recap and plan Day 1; stop early and sleep.

targets: Start streak; finish the profile and baseline check
Do not penalise yourself for low baseline score

days.label: Day 1 — Aptitude foundations + measurement fundamentals

blocks.task: Percentages, ratio/proportion, averages; 20 original MCQs.
Accuracy vs precision, sensitivity, range/span, resolution, linearity, hysteresis.
Solve 15 technical MCQs; draw a static calibration curve.
Time/work and speed/distance basics.
15-minute verbal/reasoning sprint + corrections.
Timed mixed set: 15 cognitive + 15 instrumentation.
Error log and spaced recall of formulas.

targets: ≥70% on practice set as a first benchmark
Write definitions without notes

days.label: Day 2 — Temperature sensors + number/letter reasoning

blocks.task: Number series, letter series, coding-decoding; 25 timed questions.
RTD, Pt100, thermocouple Seebeck effect, thermistor NTC/PTC, thermowell.
Temperature scaling/calculation MCQs; compare sensors by range, accuracy and application.
Strain gauge, load cell, gauge factor and Wheatstone bridge balance.
Logical deduction and direction sense.
Timed temperature + cognitive sectional test.
Correct every wrong answer; revise sensor comparison matrix.

targets: Explain RTD vs thermocouple in 60 seconds
≥75% in temperature question set

days.label: Day 3 — Pressure measurement + arithmetic applications
days.focus: Gauge/absolute/DP pressure; profit-loss, interest and mixtures

blocks.task: Profit-loss, discounts, simple interest, mixtures; 20 MCQs.
Bourdon tube, manometer, gauge vs absolute vs differential pressure, hydrostatic pressure.
Pressure range conversions and calibration exercises.
Measurement errors, uncertainty, loading effect and calibration traceability.
Short reasoning drill.
Timed pressure + arithmetic test.
Mistake log and unit-check drill.

targets: Memorise p=F/A and p=ρgh, with units
≥75% pressure sectional

days.label: Day 4 — Flow measurement + data interpretation
days.focus: DP flow, Venturi/orifice, magnetic, Coriolis, vortex, ultrasonic

blocks.task: Data interpretation: tables, graphs, percentages; 20 timed questions.
Orifice plate, Venturi, rotameter, magnetic, Coriolis, vortex and ultrasonic meters.
Flowmeter choice: fluid conductivity, cleanliness, pressure loss, mass vs volume flow.
Solve ΔP-to-flow square-root numericals and flow range scaling.
Verbal inference sprint.
Flow + data interpretation mini mock.
Draw a one-page flowmeter comparison chart.

targets: Select a flowmeter for 5 example scenarios
≥75% mixed score

days.label: Day 5 — Level + 4–20 mA loops

blocks.task: Mixed arithmetic and reasoning set; 25 questions.
Hydrostatic DP level, float, ultrasonic, radar and capacitance level basics.
4–20 mA map, live zero, upscale/downscale faults and 250 Ω conversion.
Zero/span calibration; solve 4–20 mA engineering-unit conversions.
Quick verbal/data review.
Level + loop scaling timed test.
Explain 4–20 mA live zero and loop benefits without notes.

targets: Get all 4–20 mA scaling problems correct in final retry
≥80% loop-conversion accuracy

days.label: Day 6 — Feedback, PID and control valves

blocks.task: Time/work, rates and probability mixed set.
Open vs closed loop, PV/SP/MV, feedback, P/I/D actions, steady-state error.
Cascade vs feedforward; first-order time constant/dead time overview.
Control-valve actuator, positioner and fail-state selection by hazard.
20-question mixed reasoning sprint.
Control-system sectional mock.
Draw a closed-loop block diagram and annotate PV/SP/MV.

targets: Explain PID terms and limitations
≥75% control section

days.label: Day 7 — PLC, DCS, SCADA, P&ID and HART

blocks.task: Timed cognitive set: series, logic, data interpretation, verbal.
PLC vs DCS vs SCADA; basic input/output, scan cycle and supervisory role.
P&ID tags (PT, TT, FT, LT, FIC), HART and 4–20 mA context.
Industrial safety concepts, interlocks, alarms and fail-safe design at a fundamentals level.
Registration/account and email check; do not assume assessment link is enabled until confirmed.
Automation + cognitive mixed test.
Create PLC/DCS/SCADA comparison flashcards.

targets: Give one-sentence differences between PLC, DCS and SCADA
Keep account/email ready and notifications checked

days.label: Day 8 — Electronics + sectional mocks
days.focus: Op-amps, filters, ADC, logic, signal conditioning

blocks.task: Cognitive sectional mock (timed). Record accuracy and time per question.
Op-amp ideal characteristics, instrumentation amplifier, CMRR, low-pass filters.
ADC resolution, Nyquist criterion, XOR, binary conversion and sensor conditioning.
Instrumentation sectional mock; review all explanations.
Break / walk and mental reset.
Redo weakest 20 questions from previous mistakes.
Update weak-topic ranking and progress chart.

targets: Find top 3 weak topics using evidence, not guesswork
No repeat miss on a previously corrected question

days.label: Day 9 — Full mixed simulation + analysis
days.focus: Exam-like stamina without claiming to mirror the official format

blocks.task: Mixed mock A: use adjustable practice configuration, e.g. 30 cognitive + 40 technical. This is a training format, not official test length.
Review every wrong/guessed item; classify concept, calculation, reading or time error.
Targeted lesson/video only for the 2 weakest topics.
Redo incorrect questions without seeing the answers.
Mixed mock B, shorter and timed.
Compare mock A/B, accuracy, speed and confidence.

targets: Aim for ≥80% accuracy as a personal practice target, not an official cutoff
Keep a clean list of unresolved concepts

days.label: Day 10 — Final revision and readiness

blocks.task: One light cognitive set; stop if fatigue rises.
Review one-page formula sheet, sensor comparison chart, 4–20 mA scaling and PID.
Review wrong-answer log only; do not start long new chapters.
Short technical quiz of 20 mixed questions.
Review test access, Unstop email, computer/browser instructions if available.
Confirm laptop, charger, stable network and quiet private room.
Light recall, prepare documents/ID if requested, eat normally and sleep on time.

targets: No major unresolved high-priority concept
Device and account readiness confirmed
Do not assume midnight start is your assigned test appointment; follow individual instructions
